text: Minneapolis Ice Shooting LIVE: Federal Officer Shot A Person In The Leg After Shovel Ambush | N18GMinneapolis Ice Shooting LIVE: Federal Officer Shot A Person In The Leg After Shovel Ambush | N18G Live from north Minneapolis scene of shooting amid an ongoing ICE immigration enforcement operation. Federal agents are on the scene. Federal officer shot a person in the leg after being attacked with a shovel during Minneapolis arrest. In this urgent breaking news report, we break down the latest ICE‑involved shooting in Minneapolis, including what happened, where it happened, who was involved, and why tensions are escalating in the city. Reports confirm that federal law enforcement — including ICE agents — were on the scene in North Minneapolis when a man was shot in the leg during an enforcement action late Wednesday night, prompting another wave of controversy and concern. This comes amid ongoing protests and intense scrutiny over the fatal shooting of Renee Nicole Good, a 37‑year‑old woman killed by an ICE agent during a January 7 enforcement operation in south Minneapolis, an event that sparked nationwide outrage and political backlash. #ICE #Minneapolis #breakingnews
